metadata.name: Sandsweep Circuit
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A podrace circuit through a red desert canyon: about a kilometre a lap round the mesa, with a fast start straight, the twisting Gully esses, a crest over the north dunes and a hairpin at the west end. Sentry guns on the rocks shoot at passing racers in a combat race. Race in speeders (the pilot fires twin blasters ahead), or drive it in any vehicle in Deathmatch.
